findings.description: The 'Invalid credentials' error message is invisible: the alert text colour (--danger-bg) is the same as its background, so a failed sign-in shows an empty pink box. Same CSS rule affects every role=alert message (also an a11y contrast failure).
repro: Enter a wrong password and submit
Observe the pink alert box has no readable text

findings.description: Muted text colour #c3c8cd on white/light grey has about 1.6:1 contrast (WCAG needs 4.5:1). It is used for the category column values, the table headers (Title/Category/Amount/Actions) and the 'Signed in as ...' line, which are barely readable.
repro: Look at the category cells, table headers and 'Signed in as' text

findings.description: A long expense title (td has white-space:nowrap in a fixed-layout table) overflows its cell on desktop and overprints the Category cell (category text unreadable); on a 360 px phone it overflows the viewport, causing horizontal page scroll (scrollWidth 598 > 360) and the title is cut off at the card edge.
repro: Add expense with title 'Quarterly offsite venue deposit and catering for the whole engineering team', amount 1234567.89
View /expenses at 1280 px: title overlaps the category

notes: Tested only visual/a11y; the 8 seed expenses sum correctly to $399.99. Test expense I added was deleted afterwards. Not reported: server-side invalid add form (empty title, -5 amount) silently re-renders the blank form with no message (possible error-handling issue, out of scope categories).

cost.notes: estimate from 29573 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0059-$0.0710
